title: Drasil: Adventure Awaits
description: Strengthening and connecting the branches of Minecraft without excessive pruning
body:
**Minecraft** has many branches, some of which are withered and unmaintained, or just not well connected to the others. **Drasil** aims to bring life back to this great tree by using various mods to update and integrate *all* of its branches.

If you'd like to discover everything Drasil does yourself, skip to the recommended setup section. If not, open the drop-down for a brief summary of all the features.

<details>
<summary>Drasil's Features</summary>
  
 - Reworked worldgen with continental style worlds and more biomes
  
 - Rebalanced transportation with faster minecarts and no more elytra firework boosting (if you choose to enable that)
- Expanded gear with more tool tiers and things that go boom!
 - Overhauled enchanting system completely removing the XP grind (relying on actual materials instead) and replacing boring meta enchants with Enchancement's ability enchants
   -   includes boosted tool and armor durability to compensate for a lack of unbreaking
- Expanded food and farming with new crops and cooking system (Farmer's Delight of course)
- Better storage options with backpacks and vanilla style drawers
- So, so many new and unique blocks (including vertical slabs)


</details>


Since there are certain gamerules and datapacks Drasil would rather not force for player freedom, here are the recommended setup steps for the intended experience:
<details>
<summary>Recommended Setup</summary>
Disable Spawn Phantoms gamerule or run /gamerule spawn_phantoms false
  
Enable Path of Least Resistance & VanillaTweaks datapacks

Run commands:

  /elytra-toggle rocket false "minecraft:overworld"
  
  /elytra-toggle rocket false "minecraft:the_nether"
  
  /elytra-toggle rocket false "minecraft:the_end"

</details>

And of course, thank you to all the mod developers who made Drasil possible!

This is the sequel pack to [Blacktree Survival](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/blacktree-survival) which, while still used for the Blacktree server, is built to stand on its own as well.
